verdicts.quote: Without the waitlisted member doing anything, the earliest eligible waitlisted member becomes booked in the class.
Waitlist order is the order in which members joined, earliest first, and nothing else changes it … Two members joining at the same moment onto a waitlist of 3 end up at positions 4 and 5, one each
verdicts.missing: Which simultaneous joiner gets the earlier of the two distinct positions?

verdicts.quote: there is no refusal for holding several entries, including for two classes that overlap in time.
verdicts.missing: What happens to the other overlapping entry when one entry becomes a booking?

verdicts.quote: Any existing cutoff, late-cancellation penalty or credit refund applies identically, with no extra grace for having been promoted late.
verdicts.missing: The late-cancellation rule is explicit. Whether missing an automatic promotion and failing to attend counts as a no-show is unstated.

verdicts.quote: A booked member (or staff on their behalf) cancels, or capacity is increased. Without the waitlisted member doing anything … The cancellation (or the capacity increase, or other event) and the resulting promotions succeed or fail together
the same means the app uses to confirm a direct booking, naming the class, its date and time, saying the place came from the waitlist, and saying how to cancel. … does not undo the booking
two members cancelling at the same moment book the first two waitlisted members, never the same member twice, and places taken never exceeds 10 afterwards.
no instant exists at which the opening is bookable directly. … A member who obtains a booking in the class through any path other than promotion has their entry removed
verdicts.missing: Queue priority and entry cleanup are specified. How the promoted member’s own concurrent booking request resolves, including how the two paths avoid a duplicate booking or charge, is unstated.

verdicts.quote: Promotion takes from the member whatever a direct booking would take, at the moment of promotion … The cancellation (or the capacity increase, or other event) and the resulting promotions succeed or fail together
With 20 active entries, a 21st member's join is refused with a message that the waitlist is full, and no entry is created
at its existing booking cutoff, or at its start time where the app has no earlier cutoff … An entry stops being active when booking closes for the class and no promotion occurs after that
Staff increases a class's capacity … The places this frees go to the waitlist exactly as in U-4. … Places taken above capacity (possible if capacity was lowered) also counts as full.
Every active entry is removed, no promotion occurs, and each waitlisted member receives a message naming the class and saying it was cancelled
each entry's member and the time they joined … An entry stops being active when booking closes … A member's position is 1 plus the number of active entries ahead of theirs
verdicts.missing: The position formula is specified, but a builder could store and update the position or compute it on demand.

verdicts.quote: An entry stops being active when booking closes for the class … the class's staff view shows no active entries.
verdicts.missing: Whether inactive entries are deleted immediately or retained, and for how long, is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: No page or message addressed to a member shows another member's name, contact or account details through the waitlist; a member sees only their own position.
Staff can see a class's waitlist in order, with each entry's member and the time they joined … No control in the staff view adds, removes, reorders or promotes an entry
verdicts.missing: Manual promotion and removal are explicitly excluded. Whether staff can see past promotions, including the member and promotion time, is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: The cancellation (or the capacity increase, or other event) and the resulting promotions succeed or fail together … immediately afterwards is told the class is full, because the waitlisted member already holds the place
A member booking a class with a free place gets a booking and the same confirmation and charge as before … Releasing the feature leaves all existing bookings, classes and members unchanged
classes already full show the join control and an empty waitlist.
